articleTitle: Keynote speeches: Intelligent collaborative systems and their application to emergency rescue scenario
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: After several decades of research development, we are now experiencing widespread use of unmanned aircraft in both the civil and commercial sectors. Much of the focus of previous research has been on conventional autonomy which targets autonomous flight, navigation and sensor capabilities. New application areas, such as package delivery, border monitoring and emergency rescue response are making it increasingly clear that additional levels of autonomous capability will be required, in particular, shared autonomy between human operators and teams of heterogeneous unmanned aircraft systems and the use of on-board automated planning and reasoning techniques. In this talk, I will present a delegation-based collaborative robotics framework that can be used with teams of robots and humans to leverage their distinct capabilities in solving complex mission goals. Instantiations of the framework will be considered using various scenarios involving teams of humans and unmanned aerial vehicles.

articleTitle: Equipment energy consumption management in digital twin shop-floor: A framework and potential applications
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: With increasing attentions focused on the energy consumption (EC) in manufacturing, it is imperative to realize the equipment energy consumption management (EECM) to reduce the EC and improve the energy efficiency. Recently, with the developments of digital twin (DT) and digital twin shop-floor (DTS), the data and models are enriched greatly and a physical-virtual convergence environment is provided. Accordingly, the new chances emerge for improving the EECM in EC monitoring, analysis and optimization. In this situation, the paper proposes the framework of EECM in DTS and discusses the potential applications, aiming at studying the improvements and providing a guideline for the future works.

articleTitle: Intelligent fault diagnosis of rolling bearing using one-dimensional multi-scale deep convolutional neural network based health state classification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Fault diagnosis of rolling element bearings based on vibration signal is the most popular way to avoid underlying damage for any unexpected fault. In recent years, intelligent fault diagnosis algorithms using machine learning technique have achieved much success, and many deep learning techniques have also found their way into fault diagnosis of rotating machines. Considering that convolution is the most important method to analyze signals in digital signal processing, a novel deep convolutional neural networks is developed to operate directly on the raw vibration signal. The proposed MS-DCNN model could broaden and deepen the neural networks to learn better and more robust feature representations owing to multi-scale convolution layer, meanwhile, reduce the network parameters and the training time. Fault classification experiments of rolling element bearings have been undertaken to indicate the effectiveness of the MS-DCNN model. Compared with 1d-DCNN and 2d-DCNN, MS-DCNN can not only achieve higher accuracy rate in the testing set, but also run more smoothly in the training process.

articleTitle: Digital twin modeling method for CNC machine tool
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: CNC machine tool (CNCMT) is the mother machine of industry, which plays an important role in the coming smart manufacturing. The intelligence of CNCMT has a big significance, which will enables its self-sensing, self-prediction and self-maintenance without user concerns. In order to realize the intelligence of CNCMT, a Digital Twin (DT) modeling method for CNCMT is researched, including a multi-domain unified modeling method, a mapping method and an autonomous strategy. This paper provides a demonstration of DT modeling method for CNCMT.

articleTitle: Smart steel bridge construction enabled by BIM and Internet of Things in industry 4.0: A framework
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: To deal with the uncontrollability and inefficiency problem of construction progress, quality, and cost in traditional steel bridge construction projects, this paper discusses smart steel bridge construction enabled by Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Internet of Things (IoT). The framework of smart steel bridge construction is firstly proposed. The research directions and roadmap are further pointed out. The core idea of smart steel bridge construction is to apply data-driven methods and model-based analytics to realize real-time collaborative management and closed-loop control of steel bridge lifecycle activities. It is expected that this paper will position the BIM- and IoT-enabled steel bridge construction mode in the context of industry 4.0.

articleTitle: Dynamic resource allocation optimization for digital twin-driven smart shopfloor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Smart manufacturing is the core in the 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> industrial revolution. It is very important that how to realize the intelligent interaction between hardware and software in smart manufacturing. The paper proposes the architecture of Digital Twin-driven Smart ShopFloor (DTSF), as a contribution to the research of the research discussion about Digital Twin concept. Then the scheme for dynamic resource allocation optimization (DRAO) is designed for DTSF, as an application of the proposed architecture. Furthermore, a case study is given to illustrate the detailed method of DRAO. The experimental result shows that the proposed scheme is effective.

articleTitle: Digital twins technolgy and its data fusion in iron and steel product life cycle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: The related models in iron and steel product life cycle (IS-PLC), from order, design, purchase, scheduling to specific manufacturing processes (i.e., coking, sintering, blast furnace iron-making, converter, steel-making, continuous steel casting, rolling) is characterized by large-scale, multi-objective, multi-physics, dynamic uncertainty and complicated constraint. To achieve complex task in IS-PLC, involved models need be interrelated and interact, but how to build digital twin models in each IS-PLC stage, and carry out fusion between models and data to achieve virtual space (VS) and physical space (PS) intercorrelation, is a key technology in IS-PLC. In this paper, digital twins modeling and its fusion data problem in each IS-PLC stage are preliminary discussed.

Author Keywords: Iron and steel product life cycle (IS-PLC)

articleTitle: Design of control system based on hand gesture recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Vision-based dynamic gesture recognition is an important means of human-computer interaction. This paper designs a dynamic gesture recognition control system based on USB single camera. After obtaining the image through the camera, the original image is binarized, eroded, smoothed and filled with holes, then the circumscribed rectangles and the centroid points of the gesture image are tracked, then the movement direction of the gesture is determined according to the motion track. Finally, through the gesture control movement of the mouse pointer to move and simulate the left-click operation. The test results show that the system recognition rate is high, therefore the research has some practical values.

articleTitle: A new credit card fraud detecting method based on behavior certificate
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Along with the popularization of electronic commerce (e-commerce), the problem of credit card fraud become more and more serious. Therefore, the study on fraud detection is interesting and important. Extracting the cardholder's historical transaction patterns is an important way of detecting fraud. In this paper we proposes a new credit card fraud detection system (FDS) based on behavior certificate (BC) which reflects cardholders' transaction habits. In our method, the correlation between behavior features and some special cases such as festival and weekend are considered into BC. First, we extract a set of behavior features from each cardholder's transaction records. Then we construct her/his BC based on these behavior features. Finally, we compute the risk degree for each cardholder's incoming transaction based on her/his BC. If the degree is higher than a threshold, it is considered as a fraud. Our experiment shows the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Emergency healthcare resource requirement analysis: A stochastic timed Petri net approach
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: A health emergency is a situation that poses an immediate risk to health and life and requires urgent intervention to prevent it from getting worse. An efficient clinic workflow and adequate provisioning of various types of resources in an emergency department (ED) help improve the timeliness of emergency care services. Such resources include doctors, physician assistants, registered nurses, registration clerks, examination beds, CT machines, etc. This paper proposes a simulation framework that supports the analysis of optimal provisioning of resources that ensures timely care service and meanwhile incurs no excessive cost from unnecessary resources acquisition. A stochastic timed Petri net based healthcare workflow and resource modeling technique is presented.

articleTitle: An ant colony algorithm-based approach for cost-effective data hosting with high availability in multi-cloud environments
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: In this age of information, data plays an increasingly important role. Nowadays, with the development and popularization of cloud computing, more and more enterprises and personal users choose to put their applications and data into the cloud. However, most of them tend to use single cloud because of convenience and cheap storage price in the short term. This may lead to some challenges and risks, such as vendor lock-in, data low-availability, and data privacy risks. Recently, multi-cloud has attracted considerable interests. In this paper, an ant colony algorithm-based approach is proposed for data hosting in multi-cloud environments, which is subjected to optimization objectives including cost and availability. Extensive experiments are performed to evaluate the proposed method, which are driven by real-world cloud services information.

articleTitle: An opposition-based particle swarm optimization algorithm for noisy environments
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is a population-based algorithm designed to tackle various optimization problems. However, its performance deteriorates significantly when optimization problems are subjected to noise. PSO is strongly influenced by each particle's own previous best one and global best one, which may lead to premature convergence and fall into local optima. This also holds true for various PSO variants dealing with optimization problems in noisy environments. Opposition-based learning (OBL) is well-known for its ability to increase population diversity. In this paper, we propose hybrid PSO algorithms that introduce OBL into a PSO variant for improving the latter's performance. The proposed hybrid algorithm employs probabilistic OBL for particle swarm. In contrast to other integrations of PSO and OBL, we select the top fittest particles from the current swarm and its opposite swarm to improve the entire swarm's fitness. Experiments on 10 benchmark functions subject to different levels of noise show that the proposed algorithm has better performance in most cases.

articleTitle: An empirical study of machine learning algorithms for cancer identification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Predicting cancer disease state is an important problem in the cancer discovery process. For example, discriminating between benign and malignant tumors improves the medical diagnosis of cancer. Although technological advancing led to the generation of data pertaining to patients with different disease states, evaluating the prediction performance of machine learning algorithms would be an important step. In this paper, we propose using machine learning algorithms such as a variant of AdaBoost, deepboost, xgboost and support vector machines and evaluate them using area under curve and accuracy on real clinical data related to thyroid cancer, colon cancer and liver cancer. Experimental results show the good performance of SVM.

articleTitle: Analysis of double-resource flexible job shop scheduling problem based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: The classic job shop scheduling problem mainly focuses on one kind of manufacturing resources, such as machine tools, and etc. But the job shop scheduling in practical production activities always needs to consider the constraints of different manufacturing resources. In this paper, a double-resource flexible job shop scheduling problem (DFJSSP) is presented. Both machines and workers are considered in the process of job shop scheduling in this DFJSSP. And a genetic algorithm (GA) is used to solve this problem, in which a new well designed three-layer chromosome encoding method has been adopted and some effective crossover and mutation operators are designed. Finally, a case study is used to validate the method.

articleTitle: Combinatorial inertial guidance system for an automated guided vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: The guidance system is an important component of AGV. In order to obtain the guidance system with low cost, high flexibility and precision, a combinatorial inertial guidance method is proposed in this paper. The inertial guidance system is composed of the encoder and the inertial measurement unit (IMU). And, on this basis, the magnetic sensor (MS) is added to correct the cumulative error. Moreover, because the IMU and MS can't identify the current location of AGV, this paper adopts the passive RFID tag to calibrate the important location of AGV to assist the AGV positioning. In addition, in order to obtain more accurate control parameters, the kalman filter (KF) is used for data processing in the system. Finally, the experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Analysis of RFID datasets for smart manufacturing shop floors
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology has received a widespread attention due to its versatility. With the wide implementation of RFID technology in manufacturing sites such as shop floors, typical production could be converted into smart manufacturing environment where more and more data are collected and accumulated. Big data analytics provide a good solution to process and analyze data in supporting manufacturing management. This paper introduces a case study of a given RFID dataset from manufacturing shop floors and realizes the data cleansing and data clustering algorithms in Python. Key findings and observations are obtained, which can be used for further investigation.

articleTitle: Constructing a vertical knowledge graph for non-traditional machining industry
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Knowledge graph is powerful tool for knowledge based engineering. In this paper, a vertical knowledge graph is proposed for the non-traditional machining. Firstly, the definition and classification of the knowledge graph are proposed. Then, the construct flow and key techniques are discussed in details for the construction of vertical knowledge graph. Finally, a vertical knowledge graph of EDM (electrical discharge matching) is proposed as a case study to illustrate the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Speech emotion recognition based on deep belief network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: The paper introduces the continuous model and the discrete model of speech emotion recognition, and then it introduces the popular speech emotion databases. This paper analyzes different characteristics to make a better description of speech emotion. The main works of this paper are the selection of the database, the extraction of emotion features, and the selection of classification algorithm. Then, two methods are used to evaluate the result, including overall and average recognition rate. This paper uses contrastive divergence algorithm on emotion feature extraction. Compared with the traditional algorithms, such as support vector machine (SVM) and artificial neural network (ANN), the accuracy of test emotion sample has a better performance after feature extraction by DBN, to about 5% higher than traditional classification algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on self-turning minimum variance control algorithm in non-minimum phase system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Nowadays, with the development of modern automatic production, the applicability of automatic control algorithm has been expected for higher requirements, especially in the field of modern engineering. In this paper, we have studied the traditional self-turning control method by minimum variance, analyzing its shortcomings in system identification and model construction. At the same time, to make up for the limitation that it is not suitable for non-minimum phase system, a method to increase the state tracker by using system stabilization is proposed. This method solves the problem of how to design the self-turning minimum variance control in non-minimum phase system.

articleTitle: Optimal bus lane reservation with uncertain impact
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This paper studies a robust bus lane reservation problem with discrete scenarios for efficient bus transit to handle uncertain negative traffic impact due to reserved lanes where a scenario represents a possible discretization of the negative impact at a given time period. The goal is to select some lanes from the transit network to be reserved for time-efficient bus transit while minimizing the worst total negative impact over all scenarios. To solve this challenging problem, we formulate it as a mixed-integer linear programming model, which is solved using commercial optimization software package CPLEX 12.7. Computational results for randomly generated instances show that the proposed approach is feasible in solving this robust bus lane reservation problem of a certain scale.

articleTitle: In-network multi-sensors query aggregation algorithm for wireless sensor networks database
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: In-network adaptive query optimization for Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) database considered as a distributed database has been a wide research field. Due to a limited battery of sensors, the research direction regarding energy efficiency has attracted increasing interest in different monitoring applications for extending the lifetime of WSNs. Finding the best aggregation node for multi-sensors query optimization in WSNs is achieving this goal. In this work, in-network distributed data aggregation is studied. We propose In-network Aggregation Algorithms (InAA), which can be used in both Tree-based network structure and Graph-based network structure, for finding the best aggregation node and scheduling the transmission of the data packet. Firstly, we analyze how this algorithm could find the optimal aggregation node. Then, we show the query execution scheme generated by InAA is the most energy efficient. Finally, we evaluate the performance of InAA by a case study and give some future research works.

articleTitle: Modified ACO for home health care scheduling and routing problem in Chinese communities
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This paper studies the Home Health Care Scheduling and Routing Problem (HHCSRP) in Chinese communities, in which patients are located intensively. Significantly, HHCSRP in Chinese communities need to consider the intensive distributions of patients and their vertical locations, which are different from the same problem in Europe. In the mix integer programming model, three main factors are considered, including uncertain service time, time windows and match qualities. Therefore a modified Ant-colony optimization is utilized, four instances are analyzed and management science significances are provided.

articleTitle: Solving the last mile delivery problem using iterated local search approach
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This paper deals with a real-life vehicle routing problem (VRP) called the last mile delivery problem (LMDP). We formulate this problem into a mixed integer linear programming model, which can be viewed as a combination of the capacitated VRP, the multi-depot VRP, the open VRP and the pickup-and-delivery problem with time windows (PDPTW). To solve the LMDP, we develop a meta-heuristic algorithm based on iterated local search, in which an adaptive large neighborhood search is applied in the perturbation phase to enlarge the search scope. Results from the computational experiments show that the proposed approach performs well when applied to the benchmark instances. Furthermore, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm by applying it to some real cases of the LMDP.

articleTitle: Experimental study on a spiral heat exchange process using DCS device
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: In this paper, modelling and experiment of a spiral heat exchange process using DCS device are proposed. That is, considering internal structure of a spiral heat exchanger, an effective internal fluid mathematical model is established using heat absorption variance. Finally, simulation results and experiment results using the spiral heat exchanger with Distributed Control System (DCS) device are shown to confirm the effectiveness of the mathematical modelling.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of haptic sensing interface for ankle rehabilitation robotic platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: To solve the problem of rapidly increasing of patients with movement disorders and the aging population, Many researchers pay attention to the design of human-computer interaction interface for rehabilitation training, which can provide patients with a humanized interactive environment for human-computer interaction. There are large individual differences in interactive interface based on biological signals, so the interaction interface based on haptic sensor for rehabilitation robot is studied in this paper. An interaction interface for an ankle rehabilitation robot based on haptic sensor is designed and implemented, which mainly including rehabilitation robot interaction interface hardware system, interactive information measurement and software control system. Experiments based on interaction interface verified the availability of the hardware circuit of each sensor module and the effectiveness of the interactive information measurement and software control system of the rehabilitation robot. It provides a solution for the rehabilitation training and interactive robot control based on haptic sensor.

articleTitle: A method of key links identification in command and control network based on bridging coefficient
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Key links play a vital role in the flow of command and control network information. Considering the allegations of command and control network bridging phenomenon exists, and the critical link identification methods do not take into account the impact of the neighbor nodes at both endpoints on a key link. Here, a novel method of key link identification in command and control networks based on an edge bridging coefficient is proposed. The method first calculates the sum of reachable secondary and tertiary paths between the two endpoints of the key edge, then calculate the ratio between the product of the augment degree with the endpoints and the former sum to determine the criticality of the edge. The results of simulation show that this method can efficiently and accurately identify the key link of command and control network.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal analysis of mobile phone data for interaction recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Since the last decade mobile phones have changed people's lives. Mobile phone data can be utilized to derive the spatio-temporal data of subscriptions' whereabouts. It has been possible to study the mobility and traffic estimation with applications ranging from disaster management to disease epidemiology. In this work, we have focused on the use of Call Detail Records (CDRs) to explore and interpret patterns embedded in interaction flows of people through their mobile phone calls. To do so, we consider the geographical context of cell towers to discover structures of spatio-temporal interaction communities in Macau. We have explored the inter and intra-polygon interaction flows. The results suggest that subscriptions tend to communicate within a spatial-proximity community. Understanding such insight is essential for resource optimization in network planning and content distribution.

articleTitle: Satellite resource description and search based on hybrid granularity
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: In the satellite networks, satellite resources characterized by a heterogeneous network cause the problem of the absence of the unified organizational planning and its description and handling. A hybrid granularity-based resource description method was proposed in this paper, which divided understratum resources into four categories. They were processor resource, orbit resource, communication resource, and load resource. The resource attribute of each category was defined and described fine-granularity by RDF. In order to improve the efficiency of resource search, it sacrificed partial storage space of satellite nodes to cache the index information of other nodes resources in each node, and the nodes can dynamically maintain resource indexes. As a result, the index of resource was established in the satellite networks, so it can achieve resource description and faster search in satellite networks. The simulation results indicate that hybrid granularity-based resource search is better than flood_request algorithm and CAR in successful search rate and response time.

articleTitle: Scheduling of FMS based on binary decision diagram and Petri net
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: For flexible manufacturing systems (FMSs), this paper presents a symbolic and intelligent approach to obtain optimal schedule paths by combining reduced ordered binary decision diagrams (ROBDDs) and intelligent search techniques based on the Petri net (PN) models. First, FMSs are modeled via place-timed PNs which contain processing time information on activity places. Then, a ROBDD technique is given to represent the evolution of such nets and the A∗ search on their reachability graphs. ROBDDs can represent large sets of data with compact shared structures and allow the efficient computation on those sets. Thus, the proposed approach is efficient in finding scheduling paths for FMSs.

articleTitle: A channel rail gauge detection system of modern tram
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Gauge is a very important parameter of the rail geometric state, the regular detection of the gauge value can effectively to assure operational safety of the vehicle. However, there are few researches and equipments for the detection of the channel rail gauge of the modern tram at present. Therefore, this paper proposed a channel rail gauge detection system based on the principle of laser triangulation. The system consists of photoelectric encoder, 2D laser scanner, ethernet switch, and data processing system. At first, the photoelectric encoder emit a TTL trigger the two 2D laser scanners to scan the left and right channel rail and obtain the outline data at the same time. Next, the outline data is transmitted to computer via ethernet switch, and then processing the outline data. The system adopt gaussian filter to reduce the system error and carry out an gauge point extraction algorithm to accurately calculate the gauge value. The experiment results demonstrated that the accuracy of the gauge detection system are limited to the ± 0.6 mm range, the detection precision is excellent, and the detection system can be realized in gauge detection of channel rail.

articleTitle: Multi-objective unit commitment under hybrid uncertainties: A data-driven approach
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: In recent years, the growing penetration of renewable energy has increased the level of uncertainty in power systems, which brings challenges to modern unit commitment. This paper develops a data-driven unit commitment model with multi-objectives under wind power and load uncertainties. In particular, the distribution of the above uncertainties are estimated by a non-parameter kernel density method whose bandwidth is optimized to get more reliable and cost-effective UC solutions. To solve the complicated model, a reinforcement learning-based multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. Finally, several experiments were carried out to demonstrate the effectiveness of this research.

Author Keywords: reinforcement learning based multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Analysis of urban traffic jam formation based on extended cell transmission model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This work proposes an extended cell transmission model to describe traffic flow in urban networks. In the model, the paths of vehicles travelling toward a road link are depicted for the first time. Based on the model, a simulation approach is used to analyze the traffic jam formation caused by an incident under a scenario that travelers are informed of such an incident from advanced traveler information systems and some of them conduct a detour prior to entering the incident-induced congested roads. Simulation results reveal the influences of some major parameters on an incident-induced congestion formation. These parameters are the ratio of vehicles conducting a detour over the total ones and the amount of traffic flow driving to the blocked link in the traffic network. The results can be used to estimate the traffic jam size and traffic delay caused by traffic incidents.

articleTitle: Robust linear precoding for MU-MISO VLC systems with oudated channel state information
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: A multi-user multiple-input single-output (MU-MISO) visible light communication (VLC) system is studied in this paper. The robust linear precoding is developed with outdated channel state information (CSI) to achieve user fairness with the constraint of the dynamic current range of lighting emitting diodes (LED). The precoding design is formulated and transformed into solvable convex optimization problems. Simulation results demonstrate that the propose precoding can achieve a robust performance in a MU-MISO VLC systems with outdated CSI.

articleTitle: Petri net-based deadlock avoidance for single-arm cluster tools with concurrently processing two-type wafers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: A modern fabrication tends to arrange different wafer types with similar recipes in a lot in order to increase the utilization of cluster tools, meet the demand of customization, and improve the flexibility of the system. Nevertheless, the wafer flow patterns of the different wafer types may be different such that cluster tools are deadlock-prone. This work aims at solving the deadlock problem of single-arm cluster tools with concurrently processing two wafer types. In order to solve it, the deadlock analysis of the system is conducted. Then, a general Petri net (PN) model is developed for the system. Furthermore, a novel method called the PN-based earliest starting strategy is proposed for the system such that the system can operate without deadlock. Moreover, such a method can be used for real-time scheduling. Therefore, it is significant for semiconductor manufacturing.

articleTitle: First- and second-price sealed-bid auctions applied to private parking slot sharing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This paper combines market design theory and sequential auction to settle the problem of parking space sharing and allocation in metropolitan areas during normal working hours. Firstly, a market mechanism, the PC-TTCC (price-compatible top trading cycles and chains) mechanism, is introduced to share private parking slots among agents. And after exchanging private parking slots that are fail to exchange are leased to the platform. Based on the historical auction price with weight, the platform pay the agents who offer their private parking slots. The platform manages these private parking slots and some public parking slots at the same time. Then, two auction mechanisms, the first- and second-price sealed-bid auctions mechanisms, are proposed to reallocate the parking slots received from agents and owned by platform cross the platform. In this paper, the PC-TTCC mechanism with rule e (PC-TTCC [e]) and first- and second-price sealed-bid auctions are effective. This work will contribute to the further research of the solutions in private parking slot sharing.

Author Keywords: Private parking slot sharing and allocation

articleTitle: Optimal lane reservation via new optimization model and heuristic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This paper studies a transportation planning problem called capacitated lane reservation problem (CLRP). It focuses on designing time-efficient paths for a set of transportation tasks by choosing lanes from the network to be reserved while respecting the road residual capacity. For the special tasks, lane reservation increases their transportation efficiency, while for general-purpose vehicles on adjacent non-reserved lanes, travel delay may be caused. The objective of CLRP is to minimize such negative impact via optimal lane reservation. For this problem, we develop an improved model and an efficient heuristic. Results of extensive numerical experiments on benchmark instances show the efficiency of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Modeling of sound speed in UWASN
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: The model of underwater sound speed is researched in underwater acoustic sensor networks (UWASN) simulation. The influence of water's depth, temperature and salinity on underwater sound speed is analyzed using MacKenzie model in MATLAB. MacKenzie model was brought in Aqua-Sim, which is a software simulating the UWASN. The impact of water's depth, temperature and salinity on data packet delay, average energy consumption and average throughput was analyzed by simulation tests. The results showed that data packet delay is successively decreasing with increasing depth, temperature and salinity, and the effect of temperature and depth is larger than salinity. The average energy consumption and average throughput had not changed so much. It indicated that the changes of underwater depth, temperature and salinity impact on data packet delay. The calculation of data packet delay more accurate after MacKenzie sound speed model was bought in UWASN simulation.

articleTitle: General limited diffusion of small-sample information and application in healthcare
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Scientific research is often confronted with the situation of incomplete information and insufficient data, which is known as a small-sample problem. Examples are from epidemiological, clinical and lab studies. Information diffusion has been well recognized as an effective approach in handling small-sample problems. This paper proposes a novel General Limited Information Diffusion (GLID) method, which is an improved version of the Optimal Uniform Information Diffusion (OUID) method. To show the advantage of this method, we apply it to two case studies in healthcare and compare the result with that of Kernel Density Estimation (KDE), a popular approach in statistics research, as well as the OUID method. All the three methods have satisfactory performance; while the GLID method is superior to the other two.

articleTitle: Dimensionality reduction for acoustic vehicle classification with spectral embedding
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: We propose a method for recognizing moving vehicles, using data from roadside audio sensors. This problem has applications ranging widely, from traffic analysis to surveillance. We extract a frequency signature from the audio signal using a short-time Fourier transform, and treat each time window as an individual data point to be classified. By applying a spectral embedding, we decrease the dimensionality of the data sufficiently for K-nearest neighbors to provide accurate vehicle identification.

articleTitle: Petri nets-based method for component-interaction related hazard identification in computer-controlled systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: System component-interaction as an important causal factor of accidents has been critical for the computer-controlled systems. As a novel accident causality model, Systems-Theoretic Accident Modeling and Process (STAMP) can been well used to account for the component-interaction accidents. Petri Nets, which are effective tools for complex computer-controlled system modeling and analysis, can make the component-interaction related hazard identification in the system control structure with STAMP effectively. With the purpose of identifying the component-interaction related hazards with Petri Nets, this paper extends the Petri Nets to model and analyze the component-interactions in the control process of system control structure. The extended Petri Net is named Control Logical Petri Net (CLPN). And four kinds of basic component-interaction related hazards are generalized according to STAMP. Furthermore, several rules are proposed to guide the hazard identification of CLPN. Finally, a case study is given to illustrate the feasibility and availability of proposed method.

articleTitle: Model analysis and simulation of the curve ball
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Many scholars have devoted to researching a variety of factors by analyzing high speed video in football league and daily training, such as air resistance, Magnus effect, and wind-tunnel, etc. However, the effects of hitting and air resistance on ball behavior remain unclear. In addition to determine the factors of the curve ball, we first set up curve ball mathematical model through analyzing of the hitting factors and air factors. Then a qualitative comparison between the linear and angular velocity and other factors is carried out. Finally, we simulate the trajectory of the free kick to verify the accuracy of our model. The results showed that the proposed model is effective in football games.

articleTitle: Design Of Cleaning Vehicle Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: The cleaning vehicle is a special equipment for real-time detection and cleaning of the track. To ensure normal operation of the cleaning vehicle, we need to establish a remote monitoring system to collect all the state parameters of the entire cleaning vehicle through sensors to monitor them in real time. According to the parameters collected by sensors, we can evaluate the state of the vehicle's working condition and give corresponding treatment suggestions. The system collects various status parameters of the cleaning vehicle through STM32. After storing the data into the database, it uses VC++ to establish man-machine interface and give corresponding processing recommendations, making the vehicle more reliable and more intelligent.

articleTitle: A multi-objective trajectory planning scheme for parallel assembly mechanism with B-spline curves
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: An assembly mechanism based on the 6-UPU parallel manipulator is developed for the automated assembly of cabins. In this paper, the B-spline curves are employed to design the motion trajectories of the upper platform. The total motion time, energy consumption and the maximum absolute value of actuator's jerk are defined as three cost functions to evaluate the performance of trajectory. Artificial Immune Algorithm is used to solve the constrained multi-objective trajectory optimization problem. The trajectories of the actuators can also be obtained via the inverse kinematics model. The simulation results have confirmed that the proposed trajectory planning scheme is very effective to meet different requirements of pose adjustment.

articleTitle: Multirotor configurations of an unmanned mini aircraft
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This paper presents a unified static analysis for a class of multirotor configurations of an unmanned mini aircraft, having two, three, four, and six rotors. These five multirotor configurations are classified into two groups. In one group, the multirotor configurations have fewer rotors than necessary, leading to an overdetermined system, which consist of both vertical and tilted rotors, partially symmetric about the center of the aircraft. In the other group, the multirotor configurations have rotors more than necessary or as need, leading to an underdetermined or exact system, which consist of vertical rotors only, fully symmetric about the center of the aircraft. For each of four different multirotor configurations, the geometric rotor arrangement, the aircraft effector model, and the rotor speed control are described.

articleTitle: A priority rule based heuristic for virtual cellular manufacturing system with energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This paper proposes an integrated virtual cellular manufacturing system model and develops a novel priority rule based heuristic to solve it. The model can simultaneously group workstations, schedule virtual cells, and select energy consumption levels. On one hand, if managers prefer the physical proximity of machines in certain virtual cell, the material handling cost in the cell can be reduced. However, the distances among machines in other virtual cells are probably large, which may give rise to greater material handling cost. On the other hand, if a virtual cell for certain product type has priority to be created, the backorder cost of the product type can be decreased or even avoided. Nevertheless, the virtual cells for other product types perhaps delay creation because of the occupation of necessary resources, which may lead to higher backorder cost of other product types. In addition, managers can choose high energy consumption level of machine to expedite production with expectation of less backorder cost but at the expense of more energy consumption cost possibly.

articleTitle: Research on the design method of railway traction power supply cable under harmonic restraint
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: The urban rail transit traction power supply cable bears the important tasks such as power connection and power transmission among the main substation, the traction and buck stations. Due to the greater length of the power supply cable, the series parallel resonance problem caused by the charging capacitor is a serious threat to the safe and stable operation of the rail transit system. In order to ensure the safe and stable operation of power supply and distribution system of urban rail transit system, this paper studies the design and selection of traction power supply cable for urban rail transit under the harmonic constraint. The method can effectively avoid the safety problem of the harmonic series-parallel resonance due to cable charging capacitance in the traction power supply system for urban rail transit users. At the same time, it also has guiding significance for the design of cable length and charging capacity of other power supply and distribution system.

articleTitle: Traffic incident message dissemination for reducing traffic congestion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Advanced information and communication technologies can facilitate traffic incident management. If an incident is detected and blocks a road link, in order to reduce the incident-induced traffic congestion, the incident information should be announced to the travelers who drive to the blocked link. This work focuses on the design of an incident message dissemination strategy by selectively delivering incident information to those potentially affected drivers in a traffic network. Time-dependent shortest path algorithms are used to generate a subnetwork whose vehicles should receive such information. To evaluate the performance of the proposed strategy, a simulation approach based on a detailed cell transmission model is used. The results can be used in advanced traveler information systems to improve the state of the art in preventing urban road traffic congestion caused by incidents.

articleTitle: Analysis of large-scale electricity load profile using clustering method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: It is important to understand electricity user's power consumption characteristics for DSM(demand side management) purpose. In this paper, a method combine with hierarchical and fuzzy-c mean was introduced with a case study for more than 300 utilities' load are provided. The results show that our algorithm can classify a large number of samples into finite species, and successfully obtain baseline load profile.

articleTitle: A fuzzy theory-based MRI segmentation model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This paper proposes a fuzzy theory based Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) segmentation model. MRI is an imaging technique used in radiology to form pictures of the anatomy and the physiological processes. However, it is very difficult to carry out the MRI image segmentation. In order to address these difficulties, this paper proposes a fuzzy theory based MRI segmentation approach. The boundary is defined by the fuzzy theory so that different cluster with image gray could be clearly identified. Based on the identification, iterations could be conducted to optimize the objective function which is used for measuring the cluster center of the images. Experiments are carried out to validate the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A novel demand side management strategy on electric vehicle charging behavior
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Demand side management (DSM) is a classic topic which has been investigated for the last decade and further developed to embrace the emerging of electrical vehicles nowadays. The dramatic increasing number of electric bicycles in China in recent years has brought difficult issues to electric engineering, such as the soaring cost and inefficient usage of electric power. To solve such issues, in this paper, we propose an optimization problem targeting on automatically manage electric bicycles charging behaviors based on Time of Day (TOD) pricing and daily based load shifting in both peak time and non-peak time. Apart from that, a instruction based SDM strategy has been developed to specify the details of our pricing and load shifting techniques based on the optimization, we hereby name the strategy as Optimal Load Shifting and Pricing scheme (OLSP). Based on real time and spatial data, we successfully simulate the optimal daily power load on behalf of electric bicycles consumers side in Chinese City, Nanning. The numerical results show our proposed mathematical programming method provides dramatic gain in energy efficiency and reduction on electricity cost compared to traditional customer side greedy behaviors load assignment.

articleTitle: Macroscopic traffic modeling of heterogeneous road networks using coloured Petri nets
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Coloured Petri net (CPN) is adopted for representing the traffic state and dynamics of each subregion, which is derived by partitioning heterogeneous road network for taking the advantage of well-defined MFD. Firstly, tokens in place of Petri net stand for the number of vehicles in each subregion, and different colours of tokens are used to represent OD matrix between subregions. Secondly, directed transitions between places (i.e. the corresponding subregions) are defined as the possible routes between each OD pair, and time delay of a transition can be derived from travel time of a specific route between adjacent places. Equivalently, the weight of transition can be associated with the completed traffic outflow, which is determined by the existing MFD, considering the number of vehicles in subregion. Thirdly, the firing rule of transitions in Petri net is designed considering asynchronous concurrency of traffic dynamics between any two adjacent subregions. Finally, network performances can be evaluated by average number of vehicles and mean sojourn time in a subregion, etc. The simulation verifies the effectiveness of our CPN model.

articleTitle: Model analysis and simulation of the effect of hitting and Magnus on ball in curve kicks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: The curve ball force situation includes hitting and aerodynamic with the initial state. Many scholars have devoted to researching force analysis on ball. However, play football with different parts of foot is often overlooked in detail. This paper analyses the trajectory in different ways to play football and attempts to bridge the gap between the hitting model and curved trajectory model. We study the force in the flight process, regardless of the force at the moment of collision. And then using the theory of aerodynamics, we analyze the mathematical model of curved trajectory model. Finally, we simulate the trajectory of the free kick to verify the accuracy of our model. The results showed that the proposed model is effective in football games.

articleTitle: Static output feedback control for lane change maneuver
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This paper addresses the lateral control of a vehicle during lane change maneuvers. The proposed design procedure aims to answer the questions of control using cost-effective sensors implementation, adaptation to measured variables and robustness to unmeasured varying parameters. This is achieved through a static output feedback controller with preview information. The only used measurements are the lateral displacement at sensor location and the yaw angle relative to the lane centerline. The vehicle lateral model is augmented with an integral action, the error signal and the preview reference signal. The controller is synthesized using the LMI framework thanks to a relaxation method that removes the nonlinear terms. Simulations are conducted for various scenarios showing the ability of the design method to handle different performance objectives.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a hazardous wastes proportioning management system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Along with the rapid development of economy and the constant advance of industrialization, more and more industrial wastes (IW) including large quantity of industrial hazardous wastes (IHW) are being generated, which greatly influence natural environment and public health, especially in developing countries. Therefore, IHW management has become a critical issue and has drawn great attention globally. Many waste disposal technologies have been applied to stop or weaken the impact of IHW and hundreds of industrial hazardous waste disposal centers (IHWDC) have been built to manage and dispose IHW. However, due to the strict restrictions of elemental components and calorie value in a hazardous waste burning plan, it is too complex and difficult to work out the proper proportions and quantities of IHW for waste burning. Besides, the absence of an effective management system causes that the process can only be operated by manual calculation, which is not only time-consuming but also error prone. Therefore, the requirement for developing an effective information system to manage this process is urgent and important. This paper firstly designed a IHW compatibility software system. Then, a mathematical compatibility model is built and the simplex algorithm is used to obtain the optimal results. Finally, a practical IHW compatibility software system is developed, which has greatly improved the effectiveness and accuracy of IHW proportion tasks.

articleTitle: A Petri nets based scheduling strategy for vehicle safety performance test system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Focusing on the issue of evaluating operation efficiency for vehicle safety performance test system (vehicle test system or VTS for short) and solving the optimal vehicle scheduling problem, in this paper, Petri nets (PN) are used to establish a batch scheduling model with sequential job processing for the vehicle test system, including PN based vehicle testing process model and corresponding scheduling strategy. A vehicle waiting area is set in the scheduling strategy, on this basis, the complete permutation of vehicles waiting to be tested is generated and simulated in the proposed process model. The experimental results show that, first, the proposed strategy can get the minimum average vehicle test time, which reduces the test time by about 30.58% compared with the commonly used first come first served (FCFS) scheduling strategy. Second, we verify that the capacity of waiting area is 6 can help us obtain the shortest total vehicle test time. General speaking, the proposed strategy has an engineering application value for improving the scheduling performance of the existing vehicle test systems.

articleTitle: Intelligent fault diagnosis of air conditioning system in electric bus
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Air conditioning (AC) system becomes the second largest energy consumption part of electric bus, which will greatly affect recharge mileage and driving performance. It is very important to set up effective and reliable diagnostic model for AC system in electric bus. In this paper, various types of feature parameters are extracted and analyzed for related soft-fault firstly; and then new fault prediction model of BP neural network is established with improved particle swarm algorithm. There are three steps of prediction data modeling to determine the type and trend of AC system failure soft-fault quickly: characteristic parameters extraction; data preprocessing; the best particles calculation. However, the neural network model of the soft-fault diagnosis in high-dimensional complex problems is easy to fall into the local extreme point, named as “dimension disaster”. Thus, the improved support vector machine (SVM) model is proposed to deal with the high-dimensional problems. Penalty parameter C and Gaussian kernel function parameters of SVM, which are optimized by improved particle swarm algorithm in this paper, will influence the predicted results greatly. From soft-fault diagnosis results of different prediction models, we can see that the fault diagnosis model of optimized SVM based on improved particle swarm algorithm spends less training time and has higher predictive accuracy with optimized SVM parameters through the improved particle swarm algorithm.

articleTitle: Smart management for steel-structure bridge industrialization construction
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Industrialization construction is an important development direction of steel-structure bridges. In this paper, smart management for steel-structure bridge industrialization construction was investigated. According to the construction characteristics of steel-structure bridges, an implementation architecture was put forward. Then, corresponding key enabling technologies were discussed including the section division of bridge structure based on BIM (Building Information Modeling), bridge component identification based on two-dimension code and Internet of Things, collaborative construction chain for steel-structure bridge, management and control for steel-structure bridge construction. Finally, an engineering case was proposed to verify the feasibility of the proposed methods. It is intended to serve as a reference for the engineers while preparing the industrialization construction of steel-structure bridge and as a management throughout the life cycle of the bridge.

articleTitle: Qualitative synthesis of isometric handgrip strength for Chinese adults
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Understanding whether the handgrip strength requirements are in excess of an individual's capability is essential in preventing musculoskeletal injuries by repetitive gripping activities. However, handgrip strength varied among different populations. The purpose of this study was to synthesize the isometric handgrip strength for Chinese adults. We applied three databases, i.e., Web of Science, EMBASE, and MEDLINE, to search relevant articles by using `Chinese' and `grip strength' as search terms. A total of seven articles met the inclusion criteria and included in the review. The current situations of handgrip strength for Chinese adults were discussed. Moreover, several recommendations for future handgrip strength studies were proposed.

articleTitle: Study on the geometric parameters error correction algorithm of modern tram groove rail
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: In the process of modern tram detection, the error caused by serpentine and vibration and has a great influence on the geometric parameter detection of the groove rail. Therefore, this paper provides a method of an error correction algorithm based on feature point extraction for geometrical parameters detection of the groove rail in modern tram. It aims to reduce the error caused by serpentine and vibration during the detection of track geometric parameters. The error correction algorithm uses a clipping filter method to process the raw data collected by the 2D laser sensor to reduce the interference of weeds and light. Then, a segmentation mean filtering method is adopted to smooth the track data so as to improve the accuracy of extracted rail feature points. In addition, the first-order polynomial fitting method is used to fit the data at the rail top and the rail waist to calculate the error angle and the error correction can be performed on the track data through the error angle. In the research, combined with the gauge detection system, the feasibility of the error correction algorithm has been verified by simulation experiments, gauge comparison experiments and repetitive experiments. The experimental results show that the error correction algorithm can reduce the influence of the error caused by the serpentine and vibration on the geometric parameter detection of the groove rail. After the error correction algorithm, the gauge detection system can achieve the detection accuracy of 0.2mm, compared with no error correction algorithm the accuracy increased by 0.4mm, which can meet the groove rail gauge detection accuracy requirements.

articleTitle: Design and verification of ultrasonic probe of slot track for modern tram
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Due to the narrow rail web and uneven rail surface, there are flaw misjudgment of rail web and rail base, clutter appearing and low detection accuracy in the process of flaw detection for slot track. To solve these problems, this paper analyze and design the parameters of 0 ° probe crystal, 0 ° + 37 ° combination probe plexiglass wedge and the skew offset angle and the incident point of oblique 70 ° probe based on the principle of ultrasonic non-destructive testing. By doing the flaw detection experiment on the damage block of slot track, it is verified that the new slot track ultrasonic probe has a good flaw detection effect, which provides theoretical and technical support for slot track ultrasonic flaw detector.

articleTitle: Clustering and selection method of shaft part manufacturing services on cloud platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Under the cloud mode, it is difficult to select an appropriate shaft part processing service from the rich and huge cloud manufacturing services. The K-means algorithm and the extension theory were applied into the cloud platform to solve this problem. The similarity-based clustering method was proposed to preprocess the shaft part processing cloud services and generate a plurality of class clusters. Based on the extension theory, the matter-element models of service requirement and class clusters of shaft part processing cloud services were established, and the selection method of shaft part processing cloud service sets was presented. The result of the study shows that the clustering and selection method of shaft part manufacturing services on cloud platform is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Modeling of big production data storage of fully mechanized mining equipment based on workflow-driven deep coupling network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: As the main equipment in coal production, the Fully Mechanized Mining Equipment is a typical multi-stage and multi-components electromechanical system. Any component's failure will lead to the unsafe production environment and low productive efficiency. With the flash development of information technology, the production data can be collected is growing exponentially. For the multi-stage and multi-components electromechanical system, how to effectively manage and use the production data which reflects the nature of the complex production system has become a difficult issue due to the massive and unorganized product data, and the complicated interactive effects among different stages and components. Aiming at this issue, a structural data storage and application framework is proposed based on complex network theory. According to the lifecycle of production data, the data management framework is divided into seven layers, including hardware layer, model layer, discrete data layer, relevancy data layer, application layer, decision support layer and feedback control layer. The seven-layer framework reflects the process of data modeling, configuring, generating, relating and utilizing. The objective of the framework is to support the data management of an equipment manage and maintain decision-making software in the multi-components Fully Mechanized Mining Equipment system.

articleTitle: Online outlier detection of FBG temperature sensors based on image morphology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: In online temperature monitoring system for CNC machine tools, the temperature detecting data of CNC machine tools sensed by Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) temperature sensors directly affect the reconstruction of the temperature field. Analysis on the temperature detecting data can provide important information regarding the thermal error of the CNC machine tools indeed. In this paper, a method of the outlier detection is presented. The method uses the image morphology to detect the outlier online. Firstly, the sliding window is adopted to guarantee online performance. Then outliers are detected by applying opening and closing operations and sequential filter based on image morphology. Finally, the proposed method is applied to handle actual data collected by FBG temperature sensors on CNC machine tools. The results show that the method is valid.

articleTitle: Linking events-based communication mechanism in multi-agent systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) consist of several independent agents with decision-making ability. Each agent has the ability of communication and perception. It can adjust the running state through messages interaction for achieving global optimization. The accuracy and efficiency of messages transfer among agents has a decisive impact on the performance of the MAS due to the complexity between problems. In this paper, the transfer of the messages in large distributed MAS is studied and the method of messages transfer through linking events is proposed. Firstly, the characteristics of messages in MAS are analyzed and the information model based on MAS is defined. Then, the messages are formatted and classified and the relationship between different events is established. After that, the messages can be transmitted according to the relationship between events. The proposed messages transfer method through linking events is validated by applying this method in an industry information system. The results show a efficient transmission of messages between agents. Furthermore, it can extract associated events from mess messages, and provides feedback of the running state of MAS.

articleTitle: Mobile robot traveling simulation using optical mice in the presence of installation restrictions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This paper presents the mobile robot traveling simulation using optical mice in the presence of the installation restrictions. By rotating a traveling surface sample relatively to stationary optical mice, the mobile robot traveling simulator can generate the measurements of optical mice as close as possible to the measurements of optical mice of a mobile robot. Two restrictions are imposed on the installation of optical mice: 1) each optical mouse is pre-specified to have either variable or fixed installation distance, for structural simplicity, and 2) the allowable range of the installation distance is bounded by the lower and upper limits, owing to space limitation. First, based on the kinematic model, the cost function is defined as the discrepancy of the commanded and simulated measurements of optical mice, and the nominal values of the installation distances required for a complete traveling simulation are computed. Second, three simple but effective operations are proposed, which are applied to the nominal values of the installation distances: the clipping operation to comply the space limitation, the selection operation to minimize the cost function, and the reordering operation to meet the pre-specification. Third, for 1 DOF to 3 DOF designs of the mobile robot traveling simulator, simulation results are given to show the changes of the installation distances throughout three operations, along with and the associated net costs.

articleTitle: Research on precise positioning system of tram track reference points
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: The track of the tram is the basis of the tram operation, and its detection is an important part of the tram safety detection. The purpose of testing the orbit is to find out the position of the deviation point of the track and to repair and maintain the found position. This requires us to feedback and record the location information of the error point in real time when testing the track, so that we can use it for the subsequent work. In this paper, an accurate locating system of track detection reference point based on single chip microcomputer technology, sensor technology, RFID technology, laser technology and C ++ programming technology is presented. First of all, using the encoder to send a pulse (encoder is installed on the encoder wheel) > through the pulse number processing to detect the car's real-time mileage and location. and then use RFID technology, laser technology, by reading the of the electronic Label data reference point and laser pointer to determine the location of the reference points to detect the vehicle mileage benchmark to achieve mileage real-time correction. Finally, mileage data will be sent to the host computer through the serial port by using single-chip, and in the host computer achieving the real-time orbit detection car running system. The theoretical accuracy of this system is 0.9mm, and the detection precision is high. It can provide precise positioning information for orbit detection, discover the position of gauge deviation in time, and provide technical support for the detection and maintenance of modern tramways.

articleTitle: Design and research on damage block of slot track for modern tram
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: In recent years, as a new form of public transport, the modern tram has been the rapidly developed and widely applicated at home and abroad. In order to ensure the safe operation of the modern tram, the groove rail damage block is used to explore suitable method of flaw detection. To solve the problem, finite element software was used to model the modern tramway structure, internal groove rail stress changes was analysised, the appropriate internal damage distribution was determined, combined with the corresponding national standard, a new groove rail damage test block was put forward, to determine the appropriate modern tram methods of flaw detection provide detection standard.

articleTitle: Study on the environmental safety monitoring system for modern tram
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: In order to monitor environmental indicators in the modern tram to ensure the safety of running, this paper designs a real-time monitoring system for the interior environment of modern trams. In the network topology for characteristics of modern tram's unique spatial structure and environment, the system acquires data related to temperature, humidity, air quality and abnormal gas by various types of sensors, and data are transmitted to host computer with wireless sensor network based on ZigBee. The system can not only display the environmental parameters and show it in the form of curve for monitoring in the host computer, but also store data in its database. If the host computer receives abnormal data, the system will sound alarm to remind people. The experimental result shows that the system performed well, and it achieves the expected design of functionality requirement.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization of milling process for thin-walled parts
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: In this paper, we recorded the main input parameters of a computer numerical control (CNC) machine during the milling process of the thin-walled parts, including: spindle speed, feed speed, axial depth of cut, radial cutting repetition rate and tool diameter, while collected the output data: the energy consumption, time, dimension accuracy and surface roughness by the devices including current sensors, voltage sensors, etc. After that, further analysis regarding the optimization objective of simultaneously minimum surface roughness, energy consumption and machining time was carried out using Pareto analysis and Weighted Signal-to-Noise Ratio.

articleTitle: Research on operation model of process cluster supply chain
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: As a new mode of regional economic development, industrial cluster provides a natural platform for the cooperation, the integration of resources optimization and the enhancement of production flexibility between small and medium-sized enterprises. More and more scholars pay more attention to the research of complex supply chain network operation in industrial clusters. This paper makes a detailed comparison of production characteristics between process supply chain and discrete (assembly) supply chain in an industrial cluster. Relationships between the two supply chain conversions and the corresponding supply chain structure are pointed out. According to the collaboration among the participants in the cluster, six operation models of the process cluster supply chain are proposed. The characteristics of each operation mode are analyzed, which provides an important reference for the researchers of the operation and management of the process cluster supply chain.

articleTitle: A coordination mechanism for scheduling game on parallel machines with flexible maintenance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: This paper considers a scheduling game problem on identical parallel machines with flexible and periodic maintenance. Each machine needs to be maintained periodically, and the interval of any two consecutive maintenance activities is in a given time window. Each job is owned by a selfish agent, whose objective is to minimize the completion time of its job. The system's objective is to minimize the makespan. We design an LPT-NF coordination mechanism based on the longest processing time (LPT) and next fit (NF) rules. Then we give a greedy LPT-NF algorithm to obtain the Nash Equilibrium, and the lower bound of the optimal solution. Finally, we evaluate the performance of the LPT-NF coordination mechanism with a set of computational experiments, and analyze the impact of maintenance time, the minimum maintenance spacing, and the maximum maintenance spacing on the Nash Equilibrium solutions. The results show that the Nash Equilibrium is very close to the optimal solution for all the experiments. In addition, it is shown that the LPT-NF coordination mechanism works well and tends to perform better when facing the larger-scale scenarios.

articleTitle: Design and development of a thermal error compensator based on CPS for CNC machine tools
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: scheduling; learning (artificial intelligence); production engineering computing; feature extraction; road traffic; pattern classification; road vehicles; Petri nets; integer programming; wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Impacts of health information technology on health care quality in hospital-related settings: A systematic review
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 15th International Conference on Networking, Sensing and Control (ICNSC)
abstract: The impacts of health information technologies (HITs) on care quality have become a major concern in health care industry. However, pertinent review studies focusing on hospital-related settings are few in numbers. To this end, the authors conducted a systematic literature review in the latest published literature indexed in two electronic databases (i.e., CINAHL Plus and MEDLINE) to identify such impacts on four major areas: health care timeliness and effectiveness, care providers/patients adherence and their perceived care quality. Data drawn from 20 eligible articles were synthesized in this review. In total, 11 studies (55%) showed positive effects of HITs on care quality, six (30%) showed mixed or limited effects, two (10%) showed no effects, and one (5%) showed negative effects.
